newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN CASTOR STEADY AHEAD OF INDEPENDENCE WEEKEND.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN CASTOR STEADY AHEAD OF INDEPENDENCE WEEKEND.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery held steady at 1,168/1,170 rupees per quintal amid limited activity on Thursday, dealers said.

Volume was dull as major operators kept to the sidelines ahead of the Independence Day series of holidays but sentiment was subdued amid higher supplies and sluggish overseas demand. No trading was reported in the December delivery.
Daily average arrivals of castorseed in Gujarat were steady at 10,000/12,000 bags (75 kg) each.
Groundnut oil fell to 371/372 rupees per 10 kg from 375 rupees amid sluggish demand coupled with improved arrivals of 80/100 tonnes. In Rajkot prices fell by 10 rupees at 578/580 rupees per 15 kg.
"Reports of satisfactory rain in the producing centres also subdued market sentiment," one miller said.
In Bombay imported palm-oil was steady at 258/260 rupees per 10 kg but the undercurrent was weak as traders expect arrivals of 10,000/12,000 tonnes of palm-oil at Bombay port next week.
"I am expecting two vessels shortly," one miller said.
The Bombay oil and oilseeds (ready and forward) market will remain officially closed on Friday for Independence Day and on Monday for the Coconut Day festival.
